create.name: Mikey Noechel
create.bio:
Mikey Noechel, who also teaches under the name Mikey Livid, is a Buddhist meditation teacher in Nashville who leads and co-directs Wild Heart Meditation Center, a donation-based sangha on the city's east side. He first learned to lead groups through the Against the Stream community, studying with JoAnna Hardy and Vinny Ferrero, and in 2020 received lay ordination as a Dharmacharya, a dharma teacher authorised in both Theravada and Mahayana lineages, from Ven. Pannavati Bhikkhuni and Ven. Pannadipa Bhikkhu. He also holds a master's degree in counselling psychology.

His talks pair the early teachings on mindfulness, impermanence, death and the spiritual faculties with frank, everyday language, and he is open about the punk scene he came from; he sings in a punk band and co-hosts a podcast linking punk culture and hope. Each week he leads a Sunday session of meditation, talk and discussion at Wild Heart, and he takes practice beyond the meditation hall into jails and other community settings. With fellow Wild Heart teachers he runs residential retreats at St. Mary's Sewanee and other centres in the South, and many of his talks are shared on the centre's YouTube channel. He is writing a book that reads the dharma through horror films and heartbreak.

courses.title: What Becomes of the Broken Hearted? A New Year's Eve Meditation Retreat with Mikey Noechel and Matty Finn
courses.description: A residential retreat over the turn of the year at the WJ Kelly Retreat Center, co-led with Matty Finn. It looks at how a broken heart can either close around itself or open into connection and compassion, drawing on the image of the lotus growing from mud.

courses.title: The Unification of Mind: Cultivation of Samadhi Silent Meditation Retreat
courses.description: A silent winter retreat at St. Mary's Sewanee, co-taught with Andrew Chapman, given to gathering a scattered mind into stillness and steady concentration, the ground from which insight can grow.

courses.title: Sunday Dharma & Discussion at Wild Heart
courses.description: A weekly drop-in gathering at the centre on Gallatin Pike, with a guided meditation, a dharma talk and open discussion; Mikey leads the late-morning Sunday session in rotation with another teacher. No booking or prior experience is needed.

free_resources.title: Mindfulness of the Six Senses with Rev. Mikey Noechel (Talk and Guided Meditation)
free_resources.description: A recorded evening at Wild Heart combining a talk on noticing experience through each of the six sense doors with a guided sitting that puts it into practice.
